features.name: Sales Order Agent
features.description: An AI-powered agent that reads emails, understands customer requests for sales quotes, creates quotes in Business Central with multiple lines, matches pricing and SKUs, generates emails while staying within permissions and working securely.
features.status_evidence_quote: all of this is now available for you to try in the priv in the public preview and we have expanded this p public
caveats: Expanded to multiple countries but not worldwide yet
Early preview stage with ongoing feedback incorporation

features.name: Sales Order Agent Item Availability Feature
features.description: A dedicated capability allowing the sales order agent and end users to check and assess item availability based on location, requested delivery date, and quantity.
caveats: Part of sales order agent public preview

features.name: Sales Order Agent Email Insights
features.description: Enhancement to the agent-generated emails to include availability information, discounts, and pricing details in AI-generated templates.
caveats: Developed based on private preview feedback

features.name: Sales Order Agent Auto-Create Customer
features.description: Capability for the agent to automatically generate a customer if it cannot find one, using email box information for testing and operational purposes.
caveats: Applies only when customer is not found

features.name: Sales Order Agent PDF Preview
features.description: Ability to preview PDFs within Business Central, with benefits to both the sales order agent and end users.

features.name: Agent Billing Capability
features.description: A consumption-based billing model for agent usage where agents are monetized in consumption units called messages. Messages are charged when events occur and the agent performs operations like creating emails or quotes, available as prepaid capacity packs or pay-as-you-go.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is something new which is entering into the world of business central is a is a agent billing capability while in private preview
caveats: Consumption model with messages as the unit

features.name: Payables Agent
features.description: An AI-powered agent that reads incoming invoices using Azure intelligence, captures invoice information from PDFs, allocates charges to accounts using AI knowledge, splits items by variance, handles prepaid items with deferral codes, and automates the invoice entry process similar to a bookkeeper or accountant.
features.status_evidence_quote: So that's uh coming in business central right now. If we talk about coming uh in business central it's in private preview
caveats: Some components also in private preview including e-document connector

features.name: E-Document Connector
features.description: Component supporting PDF, SharePoint, OneDrive, and various connectors for e-document processing.

features.name: Purchase Document Draft Page
features.description: New page that displays captured invoice data in a full readable overview in Business Central after being read and processed.

features.name: Payables Agent Public Preview
features.description: Agent will be available in public preview later this year to process invoices, read from PDF, and use intelligent accounting knowledge to put items in the right accounts and inventory.
features.status_evidence_quote: Later this year, you're going to see a public preview of that agent being able to process these invoices

features.name: Copilot Autofill
features.description: Copilot feature that auto-fills fields on card pages based on frequent choices, recently used values, web search via Bing, and contextual information to enable faster data entry.

features.name: Copilot Summarize
features.description: Copilot feature that generates summaries of card pages by finding interesting information, drilling down into related records like invoices, and adding comments to help users learn more about customers, vendors, or items.

features.name: Sustainability Module Expansion
features.description: Expansion of the sustainability module to track water and waste, capture scope 3 emissions from suppliers that can be automated, and provide emissions reporting capabilities.

features.name: Copilot Suggest Emissions
features.description: Copilot feature that suggests emissions values for sustainability tracking by analyzing contextual information like vehicle type, hotel stays, or flight routes to calculate appropriate emission factors.

features.name: E-Document Send by Email
features.description: Capability to send e-documents via email for countries that have not mandated server-based electronic document exchange but still require electronic document transmission.

features.name: Copilot Order Matching for E-Documents
features.description: Copilot enhancement that matches orders better and records item references when processing e-documents, reducing future need for Copilot matching.

features.name: Block Production Order Output
features.description: Manufacturing feature allowing users to block the output of production orders to prevent production of items that have stopped selling.

features.name: Cancel and Reopen Production Orders
features.description: Manufacturing feature enabling users to cancel or reopen production orders with automatic stock adjustments, replacing a manual process that previously took hours.

features.name: PowerBI Reports Expansion
features.description: Expansion of PowerBI reports across all application areas in Business Central with improved layouts and filtering capabilities for areas including manufacturing route planning.

features.name: Shopify Sales Channel Selection
features.description: Capability allowing users to select which sales channels products are available on, enabling products to be sold online or at point of sale independently.
features.status_evidence_quote: One of the things we released uh recently uh as you can see here, one of them is um the capability for example to

features.name: Shopify Metafields for Customers
features.description: Support for Shopify metafields on customer records, allowing custom fields defined in Shopify to be brought into Business Central for richer customer information.
caveats: Metafields for products were in previous release

features.name: Subscription Billing Improvements
features.description: Improvements to subscription billing feature including terminology updates, UI enhancements, improved onboarding, and new PowerBI reports including churn analysis.

features.name: Financial Reports Filtering and Layouts
features.description: Enhancement to financial reports enabling users to easily filter, change layouts, save, and reuse custom report configurations.

features.name: Analysis Fields from Related Pages
features.description: Capability to add fields from related pages or anything related via a table to analysis views, allowing users to pick these fields to build rich analysis views.
features.status_evidence_quote: It's coming in one of the minor releases is the capability of actually adding fields from related pages

features.name: Field Service Work Order Integration
features.description: Integration enabling service orders to be synchronized with Field Service work orders, with additional improvements to the service module.

features.name: PDF Viewing of Attachments
features.description: Users can now view PDF attachments directly in the Business Central client without needing to download and open them separately.

features.name: Resizing of Fact Boxes
features.description: Users can now resize fact boxes on pages to optimize screen estate usage and improve visibility of field labels.

features.name: Optimized Screen Estate Usage and Field Label Visibility
features.description: Improvements to display of field labels that were previously cut off, allowing users to quickly understand cart page contents at a glance.

features.name: Community Code Contributions
features.description: Business Central product receives contributions from external developers with internal review processes, totaling 159 contributions in this release.

features.name: Capability Guide Expansion
features.description: Business Central capability guide expanded by 100 percent, now describing every feature area of Business Central with areas previously not mentioned now included.

features.name: New Pit Stacks - Power Platform and Subscription
features.description: New pit stacks for power platform and subscription that describe the value delivered in Business Central across releases.

features.name: Business Central URL
features.description: The announcement of business central.com domain, which auto-redirects to the appropriate region or country for users and partners to access Business Central information.

features.name: Flexible Update Management
features.description: Customers can reschedule environment updates to different available versions of Business Central, including minor updates, next major updates, and planned future updates, providing flexibility for partners and customers to prepare before upgrades.
caveats: No option to postpone updates beyond extended grace period
Updates still occur automatically after the extended window

features.name: Create New Environments from Any Available Version
features.description: Partners can create new environments based on any available version from the version dropdown, supporting cloud migration and testing projects.

features.name: Unified Extensions Management in Admin Center
features.description: All extensions - global extensions, per-tenant extensions, and dev extensions - are now available in a single view in the Business Central admin center with unified administration API for listing, uninstalling, and automating management.

features.name: Tenant Discovery Endpoint
features.description: New API endpoint allowing partners to find all tenants and environments that granted access to their application, enabling bulk automation of admin operations across multiple customer environments.

features.name: Customer-Managed Encryption Keys
features.description: Organizations can bring their own managed encryption key to encrypt Business Central data on top of existing encryption layers, meeting regional and government requirements.
caveats: Designed for government organizations and regional requirements

features.name: Word-Based Report Customization Add-on
features.description: Add-on enabling report customization using Microsoft Word for layout design, control visibility management, font changes, and selection of frequently-used report properties like company name and report run date.

features.name: Iterative Inventory Cost Adjustments
features.description: Enhanced inventory cost adjustment process allowing users to adjust inventory period by period or item by item with granular control and forced adjustments for entries considered incorrect.

features.name: Cost Adjustment Self-Diagnostics and Insights
features.description: Tooling that runs diagnostics on setup and transactions to provide hints and practical guidance for cost adjustment runs, helping partners support customers and customers optimize cost adjustment processes.

features.name: Moving Fields and Tables Between Extensions
features.description: Developers can now move fields and tables between extensions to help with refactoring and modernization of apps. This capability was previously available only for Microsoft Teams.

features.name: Resource Packaging with App Code
features.description: Developers can now package resources together with apps in the same extension where the code is presented, improving organization and deployment.

features.name: JSON and YAML Tooling
features.description: Easier tools for working with JSON formats and YAML, which are industry standards in modern development.

features.name: API Call Mocking for Testing
features.description: Developers can mock external services and API calls, writing code that pretends to communicate with external web services and receives pre-prepared responses to test integration scenarios reliably.

features.name: PowerBI Immersive Page Type
features.description: A new page type that embeds PowerBI with minimal UI chrome, allowing the PowerBI control to take full space while maintaining the Business Central user experience. Also useful for embedding other controls like POS terminals.

features.name: Direct Jump from Apps List to Source Code
features.description: Developers can stamp the source code into the app definition and jump directly from the list of apps into the source code within their source control system.

features.name: Automatic Launch Configuration Generation
features.description: Tool automatically generates Visual Studio Code launch configurations to connect to an environment, simplifying setup of the development environment.

features.name: One-Click App Dependency Listing
features.description: Developers can click a button to get a complete list of all dependencies of a specific app, then import that list into their app definition.

features.name: Posting Table Concurrency Refactoring
features.description: Multiple posting tables have been refactored to allow much more concurrent operations. Tables include item ledger entry, value entry, and job ledger entry. Running multiple batch jobs in parallel can achieve 4.7 invoices per second throughput compared to 1 invoice per second with a single batch.
caveats: throughput improvements vary from data to database

features.name: Skip Invisible Flowfield Calculation
features.description: System now skips calculation of flowfields that are not visible on the page, making pages more responsive and faster to open.

features.name: Faster Company Copying
features.description: The process of copying a company has been made much faster.

features.name: Enhanced Database Statistics Page
features.description: Database way statistics page and index missing indexes page now provide more insights to help troubleshoot performance and understand which suggested index provides better impact at lower cost.

features.name: Service Startup and Scaling Improvements
features.description: NST startup is much faster, scaling is more rapid and aggressive to address demand peaks, memory management has improved, and the system is leaner overall.

features.name: AL-Go for GitHub Build Optimization
features.description: Apps that have not been changed are not re-built and re-published, making developer pipelines much faster and more efficient.

features.name: Page Scripting Tests in AL-Go
features.description: Developers can use page scripting tests and import automated tests into online environments through AL-Go for GitHub.
